description: Return the official daily retail and wholesale price of one agricultural commodity in one district of Bangladesh, unit-normalised, with the source date and a citable URL. Use this whenever a user asks what a commodity costs today or on a given date in a given place.

commodity.description: Commodity name in Bangla or English, e.g. 'পেঁয়াজ', 'potato', 'চাল', 'rice'.

date.description: Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the most recent report date.

district.description: District name in Bangla or English, e.g. 'পাবনা', 'Pabna', 'ঢাকা', 'Dhaka'.

name: get_market_price
title: Get official market price
